The ludicrously popular Mohammed Sall was touring Senegal this month following his high profile and well received conversion to Islam two months ago. Meeting with ethnic and business leaders in every province Sall has apparently been well received as a result of his mass hiring and dumping of cheap food and much needed water into local markets.

Some MPs within Salls party have sought to distance themselves from Sall in recent weeks citing concerns over his ability to stay objective with relation to Senegals secular constitution. When asked Sall brushed aside these concerns and simply stated "we're all on the same side, I think as long as we're making sure that children aren't dying of hunger and thirst all other concerns are secondary." Whatever your opinion most people seem to agree with that sentiment.

This is Pierre Ombodu reporting for SWN, stay classy Senegal.

So way back in the day we were having this starcraft tournament and it was a 2v2. For some fucking reason these fuckers wanted to play on Big Game Hunters map with the 50k resource crystals. Naturally everyone goes protoss and we go full cannons and carriers. These guys were kicking the shit out of us and pretty much destroyed my buddies base. I told him to save his carriers and bring them over to my base, while he also brought in a few probes and started rebuilding. Since we were all cannoned up, the enemy team suffered heavy casualties taking out his base.

At this point I decide to say fuck it, we lose or we win. Send my buddy a message to attack now, with everything we have left. They had almost nothing to fight us with, and we ended up winning the match.
Hated that map too, you couldn't outkill and drain people's resources for that reason. I much preferred standard resources on the hunters map - forced people to expand.

I entered a trivia contest that was on the radio for some amazing tickets that I was unable to buy they sold out so fast. It was TOOL at the tabernacle in Atlanta. I got second behind a kid that was actually behind me in line an hour away when they went on sale. I was mad as fuck. He was using his daddys extra minivan. I was risking a Cadillac.

After I lost I took the sledgehammer from the radio strongman and beat the Fuck out of my car in frustration on the air. I beat it so bad I sold it to a security guy for fifty bucks.
